svg.title: How EdgeAI works
svg.desc: Animated diagram. 1: model files download once from huggingface.co into Chrome's cache; the Trust Panel logs each request. 2: your notes, PDFs, tabs and bookmarks are split, embedded on your GPU and stored in a local index, with no network requests. 3: your question is matched against the index, a reranker picks passages, Phi-4-mini answers on your GPU and cites its sources, with no network requests.

g.text: Models download once, from Hugging Face
Your files get indexed on your own GPU
You ask, and the answer shows where it came from

svg.text: After the one-time download, nothing leaves your computer.
